Author: Real Nunu
Name: Nunu's Windbound Bard
Punchline: MIDI Editor, Bard Workbench, native ensembles, and concert capture.
Description: Windbound Bard MIDI suite with a piano roll, MIDI Workbench, native ensembles and MP4 concert capture. Includes Concert Director with same-PC next-bar rejoin, opt-in party follow, and Shortcut Bars with game icon search and saved party macro cues.
Changelog: The conductor can cue opted-in, nearby followers to follow the FFXIV party leader from the Ensemble panel.
